date.as_written: varṣe bhujebhaturage (dharaṇīja) vāre ... saṃvat 782 āśvinamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe caturddaśyāṃ tithau aṃgāra vāsare uttaraphālguṇinakṣatre brahmayoge

notes: The chronogram 'bhujebhaturage' (bhuja = 2, ibha = 8, turaga = 7) confirms NS 782, and dharaṇījavāra matches aṅgāravāsara (Tuesday). The phrase '†yaśalache†' is likely a tole (locality) name where Śivahari resided or copied the text. A heavily damaged name preceded by 'śrī... sya' in line 3 may have referred to a reigning monarch or patron, but it is too broken to identify.
